future_check: The observed strict rate is 15.28-17.72%, slightly above the explicit 15% prior because a small number of lawful general draws incidentally land in a public D4 orbit. The count-backed predicate is applied to returned grids, so incidental matches are correctly included.; Easy intentionally stays at the demonstrated 3x3/9x9 scale while medium and hard add lawful nonsquare and larger crops. This creates meaningful curriculum separation without removing strict profiles from any band.; The clean generator excludes full patterns and 1x1 crops even though the Racket rule supports them, because public examples consistently require at least one blank selector block and a nontrivial 3x3 crop. Their oracle behavior is still covered in parity.; Multicolor and nonsquare crops extrapolate the written and executable rule beyond the four public single-color square crops. They are retained because the concrete cellwise oracle is unambiguous, tested metamorphically, and restricted by difficulty.; Published held-out output was visible during verification under repository policy. The generator embeds only public input crop morphologies and never reads output tables.; Version 3 deliberately breaks replay compatibility with 2.1 because the old distribution almost never represented the demonstrated size relation or linked profiles; deterministic replay is guaranteed within 3.0.0.; Worker-side gates establish a candidate repair, not independent acceptance. The tier-4 recommendation remains provisional until monitor v13 passes this exact source/record digest and the regenerated queue says reviewed_safe.
rationale: VERSION 2.1.0 -> 3.0.0: rebuilt the sampling policy around the demonstrated same-size relation. A ph by pw crop is placed in a ph-squared by pw-squared input canvas, so input and output dimensions agree exactly as they do in all four public pairs.; Added a calibrated 15% default-only prior over the complete D4 orbits of all four public cropped occupancy patterns. Translation in the padded canvas, concrete foreground color, and D4 orientation are resampled because the rule makes them nuisance variables.; Retained lawful generalization to nonsquare and one-through-three-color patterns, but moved it into controlled difficulty bands: easy uses 3x3 crops, medium uses 3x3 through 4x4 combinations, and hard uses 3x3 through 5x5 combinations.; Replaced nine misleading, dead, or degenerate controls with two exact observable axes, pattern_h and pattern_w. Both accept every integer value 2 through 5 and have complete min/max cross-product evidence.; Added strict call validation, returned-grid self_check, observe_overrides, an independent Python rule mirror, strict linked-profile extraction, deterministic construction, fresh returns, and a canonical RULE_HASH pin.; Added ten focused regression groups covering all public pairs/profiles, stable profile prior, every exact axis value, single/multicolor/nonsquare behavior, D4/translation/color metamorphisms, nonprofile recombination, destructive structural mutations, source synchronization, replay determinism, fresh returns, and global RNG isolation.; Added an independent 30000-draw semantic census, a disjoint reconstruction of the old committed distribution for a fair before/after comparison, and a 497-case Racket parity audit spanning generated, profile, exact-axis, arbitrary multicolor, nonsquare, full-pattern, and one-cell-crop cases.
summary: Crop the input to the smallest bounding box containing every nonzero cell. Let that crop be a ph by pw pattern. Build a ph-squared by pw-squared output divided into ph by pw blocks of size ph by pw: a nonzero pattern cell selects one exact copy of the complete pattern in its corresponding block, while a zero pattern cell selects an all-zero block.
